text.about_md:
An unofficial TypeScript SDK for the [Spaceflight News API](https://spaceflightnewsapi.net) (SNAPI) v4, generated with the [Voxgig SDK Generator](https://voxgig.com/sdk). No API key is needed.

**Run the example** (Node.js 24 LTS):

```bash
cd ts && npm install && npm run build && cd ..
node examples/list-articles.ts
```

**Regenerate** from the live spec:

```bash
cd .sdk && npm install
node build/fetch-def.mjs   # writes def/snapi.json
npm run generate           # writes ../ts
```

`fetch-def.mjs` keeps the spec's interface (paths, parameters, schemas) and drops its prose (`description`, `example`), because the spec text carries no stated license. The spec itself is not committed, so `.sdk/def/` is empty until you run the script.

**Attribution.** SNAPI is run by [The Space Devs](https://thespacedevs.com); its articles, blogs and reports are aggregated from third-party publishers and belong to them. The MIT license here covers this repository's own code only; the generator templates are Voxgig's, see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
